title: Reported Type C terminal inventory by kabupaten/kota, 2023
publisher: BPS Provinsi Jawa Barat; Dinas Perhubungan Provinsi Jawa Barat
missingness: 25 numeric regional cells retained. Kabupaten Cirebon (3209) and Kabupaten Subang (3213) have dash symbols and no observations. General notes define dash as negligible, not explicit 0. Kota Banjar explicit numeric 0 retained. Source displays all 27 rows; displayed rows are not equated with 27 usable numeric values.
definition: Source-published administrative count of Type C terminals, not a count of every bus terminal or a transport-accessibility measure.
numerator: Number of Type C terminals reported for the administrative region.
measurementMethod: Administrative reporting by Dinas Perhubungan, reproduced in BPS Table 9.1.5. Exact joins use the explicit Kabupaten and Kota sections, not name-only matching. Actual table heading and selected column establish 2023. No normalization or imputation.
licenseOrUsageNotes: Current BPS website terms section 13 permit commercial/noncommercial statistical-data use, distribution and extraction with attribution. Both 2024 PDF copyright pages prohibit commercial reproduction of part/all of the books without written permission. This audit discloses that notice conflict and stores only narrow attributed numerical facts, not page/PDF reproductions. No claim of blanket publication license or BPS endorsement.

comparability.reason: Same source/year/category, but incomplete numeric coverage and unspecified operational status. Counts reflect region size and terminal governance, not accessibility. Rankings disabled.

temporalWarning: 2023 administrative inventory; exact census date and present-day operational status are not provided.
limitations: No walking distance, catchment, timetable, service frequency, capacity or passenger denominator.
Source note is an ellipsis and does not resolve operational-status criteria.
Contents-page year label differs from actual table heading; actual 2023 column governs.
Two dash cells are not silently converted to zero.
knownBiases: Inventory may include terminals without comparable operations or capacity.
Type C institutional category excludes other terminal types and nonterminal transport.
safeStatements: BPS publishes a 2023 Type C terminal inventory for the listed region.
An explicit zero describes this terminal category only, not absence of public transport.
unsafeStatements: More Type C terminals means better public-transport access.
The inventory measures operating routes or service frequency.
Every region has a verified numeric value.
statementTemplates: In 2023, {regionName} had {value} reported Type C terminals in the BPS/Dishub inventory; this is not an accessibility measure.

sources.publisher: BPS Provinsi Jawa Barat; table producer Dinas Perhubungan Provinsi Jawa Barat
sources.title: Provinsi Jawa Barat Dalam Angka 2024
sources.representation: Researcher-authored audit receipt with attributed metadata/short excerpts
sources.evidence: Primary PDF downloaded from canonical publication page and inspected in memory. Table 9.1.5 is printed page 612, PDF page 688: actual table heading says 2022 and 2023 despite contents-page heading saying 2021 and 2023. It separates Type C terminal counts from terminal entry/exit passenger counts. All 27 administrative rows appear. Two 2023 terminal cells are dashes, not numeric zero. Table 9.1.6 (pp. 613–614) counts transport modes but supplies no operating frequency. Table 9.1.7 (p. 615) gives province-only monthly railway passengers. Explanatory notes p. lxxi distinguish dash (negligible) from explicit 0 (null or zero). Copyright page, PDF page 4, restricts commercial reproduction; current website terms section 13 grants data use/extraction with attribution. Hash refers to actually fetched linked PDF bytes, not publication-page HTML.
